text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking past a classroom
I
thought was empty...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come to a stop and lean in closer
toward the
source of the music, taking in
the beautiful and
delicate notes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I may be fairly tone-deaf, but the music
speaks
directly to my soul. Whoever this
violinist is,
they're an astonishing talent!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so it was Daiichi Ruby playing the
violin?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's like my ears are wearing a little ball gown. Swoon... Wouldn't expect anything less from that family of magnificence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I overhear some students praising the
music as
they walk by. Even as their
footsteps fade, I
remain enraptured by
the violin.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Hello. Is there something I can do for
you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I snap out of it, only to see Daiichi Ruby
right in
front of me! She must have
stopped playing
without me even
realizing!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I apologize if my music distracted you
from your
work.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Usually, I play in the soundproofed room
we use
for our singing lessons, but it was
unfortunately
fully booked today.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
In any case, I've finished practicing, so
you can
enjoy your peace and quiet
again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I struggle to communicate that I was
simply
enthralled by her beautiful music.
Well, now that
it's come to this, there's
only one thing I can do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I utilize my paltry knowledge of music as
best I
can to lavish praise upon her
performance!
However...
choice_data_list: 言葉を尽くしてスキルを褒める！
素直な気持ちを勢いよく伝える！

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'm honored to receive such
high
praise. Now, if you'll please excuse
me...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that was cold...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I bet she's just sick of getting
complimented. People
probably gush
about her music all the time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I passionately proclaim that although the

intricacies of musical form escape me,
my heart
knows what's good! However...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'm honored to receive such
high
praise. Now, if you'll please excuse
me...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she didn't even bat an eyelash at
that...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah, but have you seen Little Miss Prim and Proper ever get emotional? It's not like that was an unusual reaction from her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sob internally—and a little
externally—as I make
for the stairs with
the intention of getting back to
work,
but just then...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You heard her music? Same here. It
reached me,
all the way up on the roof.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's as beautiful as ever. Almost as
beautiful as it
is rigid.
